fields.Name: Predictive Studio Registry Check
fields.Description: Runs the Predictive Studio registry check hourly: every finding of the model registry (a model published or demoted outside the lifecycle gate, a pipeline holding more than one Published model, a Published model whose stored artifact is missing or altered, a Published model without its scoring Action, a stale running scoring run, a sign-off wait past its rule, a publish record with no status change, a read permission on the prediction entities without the view gate) is remediated through the lifecycle gate and written, with its action, to the run's Details and a notification to the job's owner.
